title: Trump, Putin Hold Hour-Long 'Extremely Frank' Call as Envoys' Kyiv-Moscow Trip Ends Without Breakthrough
detail: September 8, 2026 — President Trump and President Putin held an hour-long phone call, described by Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov as 'constructive and quite frank,' a day after US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner concluded their Moscow-Kyiv shuttle trip without a signed agreement. Ushakov said the two leaders conducted 'an objective and thorough analysis' of the envoys' visits and that Trump conveyed a desire for 'an early end to the conflict,' pitching the 'enormous benefits' of restoring US-Russian trade and economic ties as an incentive. Putin maintained Russia's core demand — full Ukrainian withdrawal from the Ukrainian-held portion of Donetsk region — a condition Kyiv continues to reject, and Ushakov reiterated Moscow has 'no aggressive plans regarding Europe.' No ceasefire was agreed. Zelensky, reacting afterward, said 'it is very important to do everything so that this war ends.'

title: Quintet Mediators Make First-Ever Khartoum Visit, Opening Three-Day Sudan Political Talks
detail: September 8, 2026 — Representatives of the 'Quintet' (the African Union, United Nations, IGAD, League of Arab States and European Union) arrived in Khartoum for their first-ever joint visit to Sudan since the SAF-RSF war began in April 2023, opening three days (through Sept 10) of direct political consultations with Sudanese parties on the conflict and prospects for a civilian-led political transition. UN Secretary-General's Personal Envoy for Sudan Pekka Haavisto joined the mission, meeting Transitional Sovereignty Council chairman Burhan, the prime minister, the foreign minister and civil society representatives, and telling officials a negotiated settlement 'remained the only viable path' to a comprehensive ceasefire; discussions covered civilian protection, de-escalation measures and detainee releases. UN deputy spokesman reiterated 'the importance of reaching a negotiated settlement to this conflict that reflects the democratic aspirations of the Sudanese people.' The mission builds on the AU's Aug 30-31 endorsement of a Sudanese-led national dialogue.

title: Russia Resumes Kyiv Strikes as Three-Day Envoy Truce Expires, Killing at Least 5
detail: September 8, 2026 — Hours after the three-day mutual capital-strike pause arranged around Witkoff and Kushner's shuttle visit expired, Russia launched a mass drone-and-missile barrage on Kyiv: Ukraine's air force reported 166 drones, 32 cruise missiles and an unspecified number of ballistic and anti-ship missiles, of which 142 drones, 31 cruise missiles and 2 ballistic missiles were intercepted. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said at least 5 people were killed and roughly 30 injured; a five-story apartment block in the Solomianskyi district and a TV channel building were hit, with fires reported across multiple districts. Two people were also killed in Russian strikes on Russian-annexed Crimea and one each in Russia's own Kursk and Bryansk regions. The resumption underscored the fragility of the mutual pause and came as the US envoys departed without a signed agreement.
